## Diagnosis

This site is mid-way through a product pivot, and the SEO artifacts never caught up — that's the root cause of weak organic traffic:

- **Old product**: "InboxZap," an email-cleanup tool (bulk-delete, unsubscribe, inbox zero).
- **New product**: "Lumina," an AI meeting assistant (records/transcribes/summarizes meetings).
- **GSC data is 100% from the old product.** Every query with real impressions — "inbox zero method," "bulk delete emails," "gmail storage full," "unsubscribe from newsletters" — is averaging position 40–65 with near-zero clicks. The only decent ranking is the brand term "inboxzap" (pos. 4.1), which now sends old-brand searchers to a page about a completely different product.
- **The blog (the pages carrying most of that old traffic) was completely broken**: the index page fetched posts from `/api/posts`, which doesn't exist (404) — so it rendered nothing but a perpetual "Could not load posts" to every visitor, including Googlebot. The old posts were also orphaned: never in the sitemap, with no internal links pointing to them.
- **`/pricing` and `/features` were linked from every page's nav but had no source files at all** — undiscoverable/unbuildable pages.
- **`/faq` 301-redirected to `/#faq`**, but the homepage had no `#faq` anchor — a dead end.
- **Root layout metadata still said "InboxZap"** (title/description/OG) even though the homepage content was already "Lumina" — a stale title tag actively mismatched to on-page content.
- **OG image referenced everywhere (`/img/og-lumina.png`) 404s** — broken social-share previews.

## Fixes made in the repo

- `app/layout.tsx` — corrected title/description/OG/Twitter metadata to Lumina, added `Organization` JSON-LD.
- `app/page.tsx` — added `SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD, expanded thin copy, added a real `#faq` section with content (so the existing redirect resolves to something) — no `FAQPage` schema per the quality gate (reserved for gov/healthcare sites).
- `app/features/page.tsx`, `app/pricing/page.tsx` — created; these pages didn't exist as buildable routes despite being in nav.
- `app/blog/page.tsx` + `app/blog/posts.ts` — rebuilt as a server-rendered hub (no more client fetch to a dead endpoint) with two new, substantive posts on-topic for Lumina: `ai-meeting-notes-guide` and `meeting-minutes-template`, each with real metadata and internal links to `/features`/`/pricing`.
- `app/sitemap.ts` — now includes every real route, including the new blog posts (previously only 4 static URLs, blog posts never included).
- `next.config.js` — added 301s for all 12 legacy `/blog/post-*` URLs → `/blog`, consolidating the dead, off-topic content instead of leaving it as orphaned noise in the index.
- Verified with `next build`: compiles clean, all pages statically prerendered.

## What's still a judgment call for you

- **The old InboxZap organic equity is largely a sunk cost.** It's not worth chasing "bulk delete emails" rankings for a meeting-notes product — the redirect-to-hub approach lets it fade cleanly rather than fabricating fake relevance.
- **Real keyword research for Lumina's niche** (meeting transcription, async updates, meeting fatigue, Zoom/Teams integrations) should replace my two example posts as a starting point — I picked these based on general category intent, not live SERP/Ahrefs data, since GSC only has old-product history.
- **`/img/og-lumina.png` still needs an actual image asset** — I can't generate a binary image file; flagging it so social previews stop breaking.
- Worth a follow-up Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals pass once this is deployed, since I verified build correctness but not runtime performance.
